map.多半是字符集不匹配，或数据本身就不是文本。Hex 只还原字节，这些字节要按正确字: Most likely the character set does not match, or the data is not text at all. Hex only restores bytes; those bytes must be interpreted with the right character set to mean anything — Chinese text encoded as UTF-8 turns to garbage when decoded as GBK, and compressed or encrypted data is never readable text. Try UTF-8 first, then fall back to GBK.
